text: dsh-reminder（DSH 网页插件）：在任务结束时提供声音和桌面提醒。它监听会话事件，在任务完成或异常终止时播放对应音效，并可显示包含任务摘要或失败原因的通知。用户可在网页设置页调整音量、启停声音、选择音效包、设置事件类别和远程中继。它还支持预览和安装音效包，以及 SSH、devcontainer 和 Codespaces 场景的音频转发。适合希望及时获知 DSH 后台任务状态并按需配置声音提醒的用户；首次使用可自动获取推荐音效包。

dsh-reminder is a DSH web plugin that plays sounds and shows desktop alerts when tasks finish or fail. Its settings page lets users choose and preview sound packs, adjust volume, and control event alerts. Remote sessions can use an audio relay. A recommended pack may be fetched on first use.
想让 DSH 任务完成时自动播放提示音
任务意外报错或取消时给我声音和桌面提醒
我想在网页设置里切换通知音效和音量
有没有办法安装和试听不同的通知音效包
在 SSH 或容器里运行 DSH 时，怎么把提示音转到本机
希望通知弹窗带上任务的最后回复摘要
Play an audio alert when a DSH task finishes.
Show a desktop notice when an agent run fails or is cancelled.
Let me choose and preview sound packs in the web settings page.
Route task sounds from a remote DSH session to my local machine.
dsh-reminder 在 DSH 任务正常完成时播放完成音效，并可弹出包含助手最后回复摘要的桌面通知；完成提醒由 task.complete 类别控制。
dsh-reminder 在任务异常结束、取消、阻塞或达到 token 上限时播放错误音效，并在启用桌面通知时显示结束原因。
dsh-reminder 在网页设置页提供声音开关、音量、音效包选择、通知与事件类别控制，并支持安装音效包和试听当前音效包。
dsh-reminder 可识别 SSH、devcontainer 和 Codespaces 会话，并根据中继配置把音频播放和通知请求转发到本机中继。
dsh-reminder 可从 peonping.github.io 获取音效包注册表，并从 raw.githubusercontent.com 下载包文件；配置、状态和音效包写入本机 ~/.config/peon-ping/。

dsh-reminder README · dsh-reminder：> peon-ping sound notifications for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) — a **faithful port** of the pi plugin [`pi-peon-ping-win`](https://github.com/Gohan/pi-peon-ping-win).

dsh-reminder README · dsh-reminder：Plays themed audio clips (Warcraft III Peon, GLaDOS, Duke Nukem, StarCraft, …) on lifecycle events using [OpenPeon](https://github.com/PeonPing/og-packs) sound packs, and shows desktop notifications — with native Windows support (three-tier audio fallback `ffplay` → `mpv` → `winmm.dll PlaySound`, and a native Windows toast notification).
dsh-reminder README · Acknowledgments：This project is a **port**, not an original work. All credit for the underlying functionality goes to:

dsh-reminder README · Acknowledgments：- **[pi-peon-ping](https://github.com/joshuadavidthomas/pi-peon-ping)** by [Josh Thomas](https://github.com/joshuadavidthomas) — the original peon-ping extension for the pi coding agent.
- **[pi-peon-ping-win](https://github.com/Gohan/pi-peon-ping-win)** by [cppgohan](https://github.com/Gohan) — the fork that added native Windows support (audio fallback, WinForms popup, event-aware notifications).
- **[peon-ping](https://github.com/PeonPing/peon-ping)** and the [OpenPeon](https://github.com/PeonPing/og-packs) sound packs / registry.
dsh-reminder README · Acknowledgments：Thank you to all of them for the original work and the MIT license that makes this port possible.

dsh-reminder README · Features：| Event | Sound category | Desktop notification | Default sound |
|-------|---------------|----------------------|---------------|
| Session start | `session.start` — "Ready to work?" | — | off |
| Agent starts working | `task.acknowledge` — "Work, work." | — | off |
| Individual tool failure | `task.error` — error sound | `error` — body names the failing tool | off (beep **and** popup follow the `tool_error_sounds` switch) || Rapid prompts (≥3 in 10s) | `user.spam` — annoyed voice line | — | off |
| **Task completes** | `task.complete` — completion sound | `done` — body shows the assistant's last response (truncated) | **on** |
| **Task terminates unexpectedly** (error / cancelled / blocked / token limit) | `task.error` — error sound | `error` — body names the failure | **on** |
| Context compaction | `resource.limit` — limit sound | `compacted` — body: "Context compacted" | off |

dsh-reminder README · Features：**dsh port default: the harness stays quiet — only a task **completing** or **terminating unexpectedly** beeps.** Everything else (session start, per-prompt ack, spam, individual tool errors, compaction) is off by default and can be re-enabled with `/peon toggle <category>` (tool errors with `/peon tool-error on`).

This is the same feature table as the pi plugin; only the host and the default on/off set changed. The event mapping:

dsh-reminder README · Features：| pi event | dsh event |
|----------|-----------|
| `session_start` | `session/created` (top-level sessions) |
| `before_agent_start` | `user/message` (kind `user`) |
| `agent_start` | `turn/start` |
| `tool_execution_end` (error) | `tool/result` with `isError` |
| `agent_end` | `turn/end` |
| `session_compact` | `compaction/end` (fires **after** compaction completes) |

dsh-reminder README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness (any profile — the plugin is installed as a profile bundle). Works on both the 0.2.0 and 0.2.1 lines: the browser-trust authority list is read from whichever service the host exposes (`webRuntime` on 0.2.0, `connection` on 0.2.1+).
- An audio player on your system (see Platform support below). On Windows, `winget install Gyan.FFmpeg` for the best experience.

dsh-reminder README · Installation (npm)：Install as a profile plugin:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-reminder
```

Restart the harness (or reload the profile) so the new bundle layer mounts. The bundle patch (`cordis.patch.yml`) inserts the `peon-ping` plugin row automatically — no manual `cordis.patch.yml` editing.

dsh-reminder README · Installation (npm)：> **Upgrading from 0.3.1 or earlier on DSH 0.2.1+**: those versions injected the retired `webRuntime` service, so the entry never activated and the settings page failed with `HTTP 405` (the request reached the static fallback instead of `/peon/api`). 0.3.3 fixes that. If the settings page still 405s after upgrading, the entry did not mount — check the host log for `peon-ping ... waiting for service`.

dsh-reminder README · Installation (npm)：On the first session where no sound packs are installed, the plugin fetches the recommended pack (`sc_kerrigan`, ~0.4 MB) in the background — so it beeps without any setup. Only one attempt is made per run; if it fails, the log points at Settings → **peon-ping sound notifications** for the manual install (which also gets the other nine default packs).

To install from a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add D:/1codeprojects/dsh-plugins/dsh-reminder
```

To uninstall:

dsh-reminder README · Installation (npm)：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-reminder
```

dsh-reminder README · Usage：All settings live in the **web Settings page**: open Settings (the gear icon in the sidebar), scroll past **Agent Presets** to the **peon-ping sounds** section. There you can:

dsh-reminder README · Usage：- see the current state (pack, volume, toggles, relay mode) and the host notice line,
- **Install default packs** (downloads the 10 default packs from the [peon-ping registry](https://peonping.github.io/registry/)),
- pick the active sound pack from the installed ones,
- set the volume,
- toggle desktop notifications, the tool-error beep, and every sound category,
- pause/resume sounds, set the silent window and relay mode,
- **Preview** the current pack's session-start sound.

dsh-reminder README · Usage：Changes are written through to `~/.config/peon-ping/config.json` immediately, so they apply to the next event without a restart. There is no `/peon` slash command — the pi TUI panel became this web page.

dsh-reminder README · Usage：> **Settings-page transport**: the page talks to the host through the plugin's own `/peon/api` HTTP route (same origin, behind the browser-trust fence), **not** through the host's settings-namespace allowlist (`dsh-host-apiproxy`'s `WEB_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES` admits only built-in namespaces; a third-party namespace is filtered from `settings.describe` even when registered). So the settings page works on dsh versions that never added `peon-ping` to that allowlist.

dsh-reminder README · Usage：To install specific packs from the registry directly, edit `~/.config/peon-ping/config.json` or use the registry's pack names with the page's install action (the page installs the defaults; pack names come from the [peon-ping registry](https://peonping.github.io/registry/index.json)).

dsh-reminder README · Platform support：| Platform | Player | Notifications |
|----------|--------|---------------|
| macOS | `afplay` (built-in) | `osascript` |
| Linux | `pw-play`, `paplay`, `ffplay`, `mpv`, `play`, or `aplay` (first found) | `notify-send` (desktop session required) |
| WSL | PowerShell `MediaPlayer` — the WSL path is converted to the Windows view (`wslpath -w` → `\\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...` or `D:\...`) so the spawned Windows PowerShell can actually open the file | Windows Toast (text-only; no icon — WinRT silently drops icons from WSL paths) |
| **Windows (native)** ⭐ | `ffplay` (recommended, `winget install Gyan.FFmpeg`) → `mpv` → `winmm.dll PlaySound` fallback (no volume control) | Native Windows toast (bottom-right + Action Center; silenced, so only the pack clip is heard) |

dsh-reminder README · Platform support：WSL audio works out of the box on any distro: the `\\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...` prefix, the user name, and the `/mnt/<drive>` mounts are resolved dynamically by `wslpath -w` per machine — nothing is hardcoded.

dsh-reminder README · Config and data：Config, state, and packs live in the **same** files the pi plugin uses, so a machine that already ran pi-peon-ping keeps its packs and settings:

- `~/.config/peon-ping/config.json`
- `~/.config/peon-ping/state.json`
- `~/.config/peon-ping/packs/`

dsh-reminder README · Config and data：| Option | Default | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `default_pack` | `"sc_kerrigan"` | Active sound pack (the port's recommended pack; it is listed first when installing the defaults) |
| `volume` | `1.0` | Sound volume (0.0–1.0) |
| `enabled` | `true` | Master on/off switch |
| `desktop_notifications` | `true` | Show system notifications on task complete |
| `categories` | `task.complete` + `task.error` on, rest off | Per-event toggles for sound **and** popup (see the feature table) |
| `tool_error_sounds` | `false` | Individual tool failures: beep + popup when enabled; fully silent when off |
| `silent_window_seconds` | `0` | Suppress `task.complete` for tasks shorter than N seconds |
| `annoyed_threshold` | `3` | Number of rapid prompts to trigger spam detection |
| `annoyed_window_seconds` | `10` | Time window for spam detection |
| `relay_mode` | `"auto"` | Relay mode: `"auto"`, `"local"`, or `"relay"` |
| `playback_wait_seconds` | `2` | Seconds the PowerShell player process stays alive after `Play()` |
dsh-reminder README · Config and data：Legacy config with `active_pack` is migrated to `default_pack` on load. Packs are also picked up from `~/.claude/hooks/peon-ping/packs` (Claude Code).

dsh-reminder README · Remote development：The extension auto-detects SSH sessions, devcontainers, and Codespaces, and routes audio through the peon-ping relay running on your local machine (see the [peon-ping remote development docs](https://github.com/PeonPing/peon-ping#remote-development-ssh--devcontainers--codespaces)). Configure with `/peon relay`.

dsh-reminder README · Development：The repository is self-contained: all type declarations come from the npm
devDependencies (no vendored or machine-specific paths in `tsconfig.json`).

```bash
npm install
npm test              # run tests
npm run typecheck     # type check
npm run build         # build lib/ (host bundle)
